description: Provision a Google Cloud Compute ComputeVPNGateway via Config Connector. Fields mirror the compute.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ComputeVPNGateway spec.

description.description: Immutable. An optional description of this resource.

networkRef.description: The network this VPN gateway is accepting traffic for. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeNetwork resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/networks/{{networkID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeNetwork resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeNetwork resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

region.description: Immutable. The region this gateway should sit in.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

stackType.description: Immutable. The stack type for this VPN gateway to identify the IP protocols that are enabled. If not specified, IPV4_ONLY will be used. Default value: "IPV4_ONLY" Possible values: ["IPV4_ONLY", "IPV4_IPV6"].

vpnInterfaces.description: Immutable. A list of interfaces on this VPN gateway.

id.description: Immutable. The numeric ID of this VPN gateway interface.

interconnectAttachmentRef.description: Immutable. When this value is present, the VPN Gateway will be used for IPsec-encrypted Cloud Interconnect; all Egress or Ingress traffic for this VPN Gateway interface will go through the specified interconnect attachment resource. Not currently available publicly. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `ComputeInterconnectAttachment` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

ipAddress.description: The external IP address for this VPN gateway interface.

title: GCP Compute ComputeVPNGateway
